title: No calibration reset after libre sensor change
symptom: After changing a Libre sensor without resetting calibrations, the results are not satisfying due to the different response of the new sensor. The user asks if it is possible to restart calibration at any point.
cause: The user did not reset calibrations after changing the Libre sensor, leading to inaccurate readings because the new sensor has a different response.
fix: Use the 'Stop Sensor' and 'Start Sensor' functions when changing sensors. The user found that 'Stop Sensor' resets calibrations, giving a fresh calibration graph with only new data.
evidence_quote: When you change sensor you should use `Stop Sensor` and `Start Sensor`
